leadText:
Shūhei Yasuda (Japanese: Yasuda Shūhei) is a character designer , animation director and key animator of the .

Yasuda began working on the animated series as a key animator during , with his first credit being for the ending animation of DreamDream. He was promoted to a character designer on , then held the position of chief animation director for . He also animation-directed the opening animations for the all versions of One, Two, Three.

Additionally, Yasuda has contributed illustrations for the , exclusively for cards related to the animated series. There are cards illustrated by Yasuda. For a list of cards he illustrated, go here.
